scoring.record: min(1, 0.6*E + 0.1*has_action + 0.1*has_object + 0.1*(num_types-1)); E = max non-normal UCF hypothesis confidence
scoring.video: min(1, 0.4*strength + 0.25*persistence + 0.2*concentration + 0.15*agreement); persistence saturates at 10.0s, concentration at 5.0 records
scoring.note: evidence aggregation only; NOT a probability of crime
